finding.summary: A throw from `getRuleFn` at module scope takes down the entire `@wafflebase/notes` public entry point, not just the preview — including the store and toolbar surfaces that never touch markdown.
finding.evidence: `getRuleFn` (packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts:212) throws `markdown-it block rule not found: list` if markdown-it's private `__rules__` registry shape changes. It is invoked from `md.use(listEmptyBulletPlugin)` at preview.ts:48, which is *module top-level*. The out-of-diff blast radius is the import chain: packages/notes/src/index.ts:12 re-exports `initialize` from `./view/editor.js`, and packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:20 statically imports `NotePreview` from `./preview.js`. So evaluating the package barrel evaluates preview.ts. Every frontend consumer therefore fails to import, not just the preview pane: packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-view.tsx:7, notes-detail.tsx:9, notes-toolbar.tsx:7, and yorkie-note-store.ts:7 (the Yorkie CRDT note store, which has nothing to do with markdown rendering). `packages/notes/package.json:63` pins `"markdown-it": "^14.1.0"` (caret) and harness.config.json:45 enables `dependencyFreshness` with `failOnCritical`, so an automated bump is a live path. Fix belongs on the new code: make `getRuleFn` degrade (return a no-op / skip the wrap) instead of throwing during module evaluation, or move the `md.use` behind a lazily-initialised renderer.
